issues.title: Jack Mode Required for Air Suspension Loading
issues.detail: When loading a Cayenne with air suspension on a flatbed, activate Jack Mode by holding the suspension height switch forward 5-10 seconds until the dash display shows 'Regulation Switched Off'. Without this, the suspension will actively fight the loading process and may be damaged.

issues.title: PDK Requires 12V Power to Shift — Mechanical Override Requires Significant Force
issues.detail: Porsche's PDK dual-clutch transmission is electro-hydraulic. Without 12V power it will NOT shift reliably. The mechanical override requires very firm sustained pressure — much more than a standard shift interlock. Always restore 12V power before attempting any shift. All Porsche vehicles are high-value — FLATBED ONLY.

issues.title: Tow Mode via PCM Is the Only Correct Method
issues.detail: The correct and safest way to put a Taycan in Neutral is via Tow Mode on the PCM touchscreen (Menu > Service > Tow Mode). This safely engages neutral AND releases the EPB. Do not rely solely on the column selector for neutral — the vehicle can re-engage drive without Tow Mode active.
